<!-- DO NOT EDIT | GENERATED CONTENT -->

Hardware definitions tell llm-helper how a GPU's memory is shared, which architecture it is,
and which flags abort at startup there. They ship in the binary, and files in
<config>/hardware.d can add more without a rebuild.
'hardware report' prints what this machine reports, to attach to a new definition.

## Usage

```console
llm-helper hardware
```
